data.notes: October currently skews toward confirmed arena pop/heritage concerts and large outdoor festival brands, with several lineups still pending.

events.title: Richard Marx Live at Coca-Cola Arena
events.summary: Coca-Cola Arena confirms Richard Marx for Saturday 3 October 2026 at 8:00 PM. The show is billed as his first Middle East performance, covering four decades of hits.

events.title: KPOPZ Live - The Ultimate K-pop Experience
events.summary: Platinumlist confirms this K-pop tribute production at Theatre by QE2 on Saturday 3 October 2026. The show is built around K-pop choreography, immersive visuals and music associated with major Korean pop acts.

events.title: God Save the Queen - A Tribute in Dubai
events.summary: Platinumlist confirms the Queen tribute show at Dubai Opera on Monday 5 October 2026 at 8:30 PM. The event is presented by Star System and features the touring tribute act led by Pablo Padín.

events.title: Sonny Fodera | Playa Pacha
events.summary: Ticketmaster UAE confirms Sonny Fodera at Playa Pacha, FIVE Luxe JBR, on Saturday 10 October 2026 at 7:00 PM. The event is part of Pacha Icons and is listed as a 21+ dance/electronic show.

events.title: Elrow Dubai 2026
events.summary: Platinumlist confirms elrow Dubai 2026 at Dubai Media City Amphitheatre on Saturday 24 October 2026, with doors at 16:00. The edition uses the Nowmads theme; DJ announcements are still pending on the source page.

events.title: Boris Grebenshikov
events.summary: Ticketmaster UAE confirms Boris Grebenshikov at The Agenda on Saturday 24 October 2026 at 8:00 PM. The listing presents the Aquarium founder as performing in Dubai with BG+.

events.title: Blue 25th Anniversary Tour Dubai
events.venueName: Dubai Millennium Amphitheatre, Expo City Dubai
events.summary: Live Nation Middle East confirms Blue's 25th Anniversary Tour at Dubai Millennium Amphitheatre, Expo City Dubai, on Sunday 25 October 2026. The British pop group is billed for a hits-focused anniversary concert.

events.title: Summer in Nashville Dubai 2026
events.summary: The official Summer in Nashville site confirms the Dubai edition at Dubai Media City Amphitheatre on Saturday 31 October 2026. The event is billed as a touring country festival, with detailed artist billing not yet listed on the source page.
